technique_name: Describe the 4 fundamentals of Object Oriented Programming
description: Object-oriented programming (OOP) is a programming paradigm that uses abstractions to create models based on the real world. It employs four main principles: object orientation, polymorphism, abstraction, and encapsulation. Object orientation is the concept of organizing code around objects rather than functions and how they interact with each other.
